name: Removing Leaders
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of appointing leaders who fear God, are truthful, and hate covetousness, as seen in Exodus 18:21, where such men are placed over the people to govern effectively. Leadership impacts the wellbeing of the community; Proverbs 29:2 contrasts the joy under righteous rulers with the mourning under wicked ones, while Proverbs 11:14 highlights the safety found in wise counsel. Daniel 2:21 reminds us that God sovereignly removes and sets up leaders according to His wisdom. When addressing unrepentant sin within the community, Matthew 18:17 instructs the church to take decisive action, including removing those who refuse to listen, underscoring accountability in leadership. Jesus also teaches in Matthew 20:25 that worldly authority often exercises dominion improperly, implying that Christian leadership calls for a different, servant-hearted approach.
